types.comment: singleton attribute database (constructed size 104). vptr at +0 on BOTH builds (PS2 ctor 0x16c668 stores its vtable at 0x0(s1)), so offsets agree up to +0x60; PS2 4-byte bools +0x60/+0x64 pack to Xbox +0x60/+0x61 and symbolTable moves PS2 +0x68 -> Xbox +0x64
